purpose: Source index and contract checks. The simulator and its tests are retained. Generated documents are no longer byte-identical to the baseline after the named corrections.
deletion_block_reason: Simulator tests remain. Unexpanded domain batches are not complete. Runtime fixtures are not executed.

counting.meaning: 121 ContractTest methods are 120 unittest tests plus 1 setUpClass.
counting.nested_structural_note: rewrite/rewrite/walk sit inside schema helpers. They are not top-level helpers and are not behavioral scenarios.
counting.markdown_html_note: Eight methods on _MarkdownHTML are class methods. They are outside the 176 top-level function count.
counting.alias_note: module_ui_targets is sidebar_entries. Counting it again would double one function.
counting.retirement_note: All behavioral methods remain pending. A fixture or a source index entry does not convert one.

intentional_generated_deltas.change: mergeMatter's description now says both matters must be visible. The MCP catalog and coverage do not inline that description.
MatterWritePatch status is prospect, open, or on_hold, and updateMatter's description keeps close and reopen on their own methods.
stopTimer's TimerStopResult now references StoppedTimer, whose status is stopped. The MCP tool still names TimerStopResult. Active Timer values stay running or paused.
mergeMatter's description says each wall value must be a resolved boolean. Null is not unwalled.
updateFileMetadata's description requires access to the file's current matter and the destination. The stored matter id is not replaced by the request.
resetTotp and regenerateRecoveryCodes require FactorReauthentication. The MCP catalog records that JSON body. A boolean is not proof.
The caller presents task_authorization as an opaque string. The issued TaskAuthorization object stays on the webhook the core sends. A caller claim object is not a grant.
POST /mcp publishes X-CSRF-Token, and the MCP catalog names that header. Cookie tools/call writes require it. Bearer calls and cookie reads do not.
POST /mcp and JsonRpcRequest say X-CSRF-Token is the HTTP header on the transport, not a tools/call argument.
createFileLink is not_found when neither file resolves. The access cases include from_visible false with to_visible false.

ManifestExtension and ManifestView include trust_entry and file_version. listTrustEntry, getTrustEntry, and listFileVersions take include, and those read schemas carry optional included. The MCP catalog still describes query as one object, so its bytes stay the same.

ManifestExtension and ManifestView add every section 5 record with a published read: contact addresses, emails, phones and tags, practice areas, counties, referral sources, timers, file renditions and links, court profiles, Doc Tender categories, jobs, results and exceptions, conflict checks and their reviews, trust flags, replenishment requests and reconciliations, plus folders and matter markers, which are matter records outside section 5. Their list and get reads take include, their read schemas carry optional included, and DocTenderResult gains its row id. The MCP catalog still describes query as one object, and coverage does not list parameters, so their bytes stay the same.

intentional_corrections.was: A background getFileUpload resume with only module_scopes=['files:write'] was allowed.
intentional_corrections.now: scope_denied. The bearer token and current approvals must hold files:write. Stale module_scopes do not replace an omitted, empty, or revoked scope.
